title: Material Blend 4-Mix Solo #18 (대각 띠·물결 | 석재+인어비늘+흑요암금+보태니컬)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 20s goddess, curvy petite physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — smallest most compact frame possible yet curves exploding at absolute maximum in every direction, bubble butt projecting dramatically backward from the tiny frame, thighs so thick they dwarf the petite frame, blunt collarbone-length bob thick heavy — her body carries 4 different materials at once, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 diagonal bands by 3 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 25% of the way down her figure from the top, about 49% of the way down her figure from the top and about 64% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries solid polished white marble fused directly into her own form, natural grey-gold veining flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING pale marble surface with VIVID golden vein striations. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC TEAL scale formations, VIVID SILVER scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the diagonal band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections. Region 4 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries living orchid blooms growing directly from her own skin, every stem rooted in her living skin and every petal standing in three-dimensional relief casting its own small shadow, BLAZING VIOLET blossoms, VIVID GOLD leaves and tendrils. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it., no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme curvy petite silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
